visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a lime-green t-shirt and a black utility vest with yellow text is kneeling on a tiled floor in a brightly lit indoor venue that resembles a temple or community hall. Another man in white shorts stands to his right, holding a golden ceremonial object. Several observers, including adults and children, stand or sit in the background watching the scene. (2) There is a sudden visual transition effect, and the kneeling man jumps up to begin a high-energy dance. He performs a horse-riding dance move with his arms crossed at the wrists, hopping rhythmically. Onlookers in the background maintain mostly neutral expressions as they watch the performance. (3) The man continues his energetic dance, pumping his fists and moving side-to-side. The camera remains static at an eye-level angle, focusing on his upper and full body movements. Background objects include traditional red lanterns and glass doors reflecting the indoor lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with traditional Chinese folk instrumentation featuring a high-pitched, resonant Suona melody supported by rhythmic percussion from gongs and drums. The acoustic environment is bright and festive, suggesting a live ceremonial recording. (2) A sharp digital stinger sound effect (a transition 'hit') interrupts the folk music. This is immediately followed by the start of a high-tempo EDM pop track, 'Gangnam Style' by PSY. (3) The track features a dominant synthesized bassline and 4/4 electronic drum rhythm. High-arousal male vocals in Korean and English (the BGM singer) deliver energetic lines. The mix is dense with bright frequency content and heavy compression typical of modern pop production, maintaining a high arousal level until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous subversion of expectations by contrasting a traditional religious or ceremonial setting with a globally recognized energetic pop dance, designed for entertainment and viral appeal.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the 'bait and switch' technique to engage viewers through comedic surprise within a cultural context.
